outcome.answer: Large language models can actively gather preference information through multi-turn questions, choosing what to ask based on the conversation stage: attribute questions work well early, while item-based questions are more useful as preferences become clearer [5]. Another approach trains the LLM to generate interactions that reduce its uncertainty over recommendations, improving recommendation quality and conversational efficiency [8]. These approaches focus on eliciting information from users; other work instead enriches existing histories or item data with inferred context and synthetic interactions [1, 6].
